display.title: Episode 549: Reb Boruch and the Alter Rebbe's Blessing, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: How to join Tzivos Hashem, Tehillim for the Rebbe, Shema with a Brooklyn class, and the end of the story of Reb Boruch, saved by following the Alter Rebbe's puzzling advice.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens by inviting children to join Tzivos Hashem, the worldwide children's club where members earn promotions by completing mitzvah missions, and to sign up their friends as an act of Ahavas Yisroel. After the Hakochainik march, the children say Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery. A class from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema, and the tzedakah is given in the merit of the Rebbe's recovery. Story time concludes the tale of Reb Boruch: a week after his summons, the Alter Rebbe tells him he may now go to the minister. There he learns that officials had been waiting that Tuesday to have him shot, but meanwhile witnesses exposed the man who framed him. Reb Boruch gets his job back with a raise, and sees how different things look through the eyes of a tzaddik. The show ends with thanks to the week's sponsors, a listener's letter about loving the Shema and tzedakah, Shabbos candle times, and advertisements.
display.lesson: Things that seem puzzling to us look very different through the eyes of a tzaddik; trust and follow his guidance.

relations.note: Concludes the Reb Boruch story begun in episode 548 ('we're in the middle of such an exciting and suspenseful story').
The same Reb Boruch story, including this conclusion, is told in episode 509.
'Saved by a Miracle' (1992): ep 548 ch. 1 and ep 549 ch. 2 are chapters of the same airing of the serial.

quality.notes: ASR sometimes renders 'Reb Boruch' as 'Rabbi Akiva'. Contains sponsor thanks, a jewelry advertisement with phone number, candle times. Child letter writer and visiting teacher named (see hidden).
